snippet.title: How to play Morpheus on the C64
snippet.description:
Systems: 
IC = Inertia Converter. Restores damage done to the ship.
SC = Solar Cells. Restores more damage done to the ship.
MS = Mega Solar Cells. Restores a lot of damage done to the ship.
CE = Charge to Energy Converter. Restores damage done to the ship when firing on orbitals.
BA = Energy Battery. Stores some energy as a backup.
HB = High Energy Battery. Stores a lot of energy as a backup.
SG = Shield Generator. Extra defense.
SR = Shield Replenisher. Restores power to shield systems.
SD = Shield Display Indicator. Color coded tracking of overall shields.
EC = Electronic Countermeasures. Confuses homing Morphai like mines.
DL = Remote Drone Locator. Locates...well, drones.
ED = Emergency Demat. Transports you back to base when you go below 20% shields.
NF = Nucleus Finder. Directional tracker for finding the nucleus.
VP = View Port. Has no combat purpose and is totally pointless.
CP = Charge Proximity Indicator. Tracks charges, ie orbitals and nucleii.
CD = Charge Display Unit. Not really sure what this does.

Weapons:
FW = Four Way Directable.
EW = Eight Way Directable.
RF = Four Way Rapid Fire.
RE = Eight Way Rapid Fire.
EF = Extended Angle Fire.
SF = Simultaneous Four Way.
SE = Simultaneous Eight Way.
RM = Remote Drone.
